text: Retry 20261013-195040-vy1x: set [landing] merge_via_rest = true in athena.toml with the reason comment, as before. It failed because the test rest_merge_is_off_unless_the_config_turns_it_on (crates/athena-data/src/config.rs) asserts that the repository's own athena.toml has no [landing] table. Root cause: that test pins this repository's live setting instead of the default. Change the test to check the default on a config with the [landing] table removed (or absent), and assert that this repository's config now turns the merge on. Only athena.toml and that test change.
